issues.reason: "announced ... that he will miss the season" is a verb of speech with a finite that-complement, and the propositional-attitudes section states that construction as one package — Experiencer = the holder plus the complement sealed under Theme — which is also the form its documented QA pattern rebuilds; the parse takes the Theme half and not the Experiencer half.

The ban stands — a restrictive modifier on a plural may not be predicated of the group symbol, which "appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself" — but the prescribed remedy is wrong for "personal", a classifying modifier that rides in the group's kind slot, and unavailable for "unspecified", since no distribution rule can be expressed inside a seal.

The modifier is a proper noun, so the compound route (which would keep it inside the fused symbol) is blocked by the naming rules, and in that gap the emitted atoms are true of the sentence's content and well-typed — PartOf's second job is exactly "a member of a group", which is what "Devil Rays prospect" states.

"is in doubt after ..." is a connective/temporal endpoint, and dual-emit prescribes exactly this pairing — the reified state to carry the Before anchor plus a flat atom — with the entity-attached surface preposition standing in for the flat copular atom because the predicate is a PP; no atom is false or ill-typed, so it is graceful improvisation in the gap the reviewer itself registers.

gaps_confirmed: Predicative PP as a copular complement ("X is in doubt") — no licensed head for a non-locative PP predicate and no licensed class for its reified state.
Causal "because of" + NP — the connectives section reifies two clauses and says nothing about a causal preposition taking an entity.
Proper-noun modifier in a role compound ("Devil Rays prospect Josh Hamilton").
new_gaps: No carrier for a member-level modifier inside a seal: an indefinite plural introduced inside a sealed complement cannot take the distribution rule the plural rules require, and a rule term with a free variable inside an asserted atom is not licensed either.
A reporter's meta-modifier on reported content ("unspecified" personal problems) belongs outside the seal, but its witness exists only inside it, so there is no place to put it.
repair_summary: (Agent sk_announce_1 devil_rays) becomes (Experiencer sk_announce_1 devil_rays) (proof name announce_ag -> announce_exp). Inside the seal, the classifying modifier fuses into the group's kind slot — (GroupOf sk_problem_1 problem) + (Member sk_problem_1 personal) becomes (GroupOf sk_problem_1 personal_problem) — with its decomposition (Inheritance personal_problem problem) and (Inheritance personal_problem personal) emitted at top level as definitional. (Member sk_problem_1 unspecified) is removed with no replacement, the gap recorded.
notes: The instruction set is in genuine tension here: the progressive test under Thematic roles makes "announce" an agentive event, while the attitudes section overrides that test for speech verbs (it lists "say") — the construction-specific rule governs, since the parse adopts that construction's sealing. BecauseOf is left standing as a CamelCase-joined surface preposition in gap territory.
